title: How to Automate Quality Audits Across Properties
summary: See how to automate scheduling and tracking of quality audits across a short-stay property portfolio.
body_markdown:
Automating quality audits means each property gets a scheduled, structured audit automatically, with results tracked and compared over time — instead of audits happening reactively, only after a problem has already surfaced. In **Jestor** , this uses structured forms combined with automation triggers.


Quality audits tend to slip in growing portfolios not because anyone decides they're unimportant, but because there's no automatic trigger forcing them to happen on schedule.


## What manual quality audit scheduling misses


- Audits that depend on someone remembering to schedule them
- Inconsistent audit frequency between different properties
- No structured comparison of results across audits or properties
- Audit findings not systematically connected to corrective action


## How automated quality audits work


- Automations trigger scheduled audits per property, based on a defined cadence
- Structured **forms** ensure consistent criteria are checked every time
- Each audit becomes a record with full history preserved for comparison
- Findings can trigger automated corrective-action tasks


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- Audit scheduling doesn't depend on someone remembering to initiate it
- Structured forms keep the criteria consistent across every property and audit
- History supports comparison across audits and properties over time
- Corrective actions connect directly to specific audit findings

## Frequently Asked Questions


**Can audit frequency vary by property type or risk level?** Yes, automation rules can be configured per property category. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Do audit findings automatically trigger corrective action?** Yes, this can be configured as part of the process.


**Can audit results be compared across properties?** Yes, through dashboards built on the structured audit data.
